comparison.objective: Hand-fit an oil filter to a prescribed post-contact rotation; candidate extracts a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Thread engagement and controlled wrist rotation versus fine probe insertion and low-force axial withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Filter tightened 240–360 degrees past gasket contact without over-tightening versus correct intact terminal removal. Candidate acceptance limits are missing.
comparison.reason: Threaded installation and torque-by-angle control do not test connector depinning.
